nodes.name: Exalted Council
nodes.tooltip: Bartuc and the Fell Council have +1 Monster Power and drop additional items when slain.

nodes.name: Cult of Annihilation
nodes.tooltip: Doomsayers appear during the Infernal Hordes. Doomsayers are dangerous enemies but also drop Aether.
nodes.seasonal: At Rank 5 with the Splinter of Terror, a Doomsayer appears at the start of each wave.

nodes.name: Council Coffers
nodes.tooltip: The Chest of Talismans will appear after defeating either the Fell Council or Bartuc.
nodes.seasonal: At Rank 20 with the Splinter of Terror, the Chest of Talismans now costs 1 Aether.

nodes.name: Forged in Flame
nodes.tooltip: Obducite drops instead of Gem Fragments in the Infernal Hordes.

nodes.name: Scale of Tathamet
nodes.tooltip: Once per wave the Scale of Tathamet may appear, a primordial relic that kills all enemies within the Infernal Hordes.

nodes.name: Flawless Find
nodes.tooltip: Gem Fragments drop instead of Obducite in the Infernal Hordes.

nodes.name: Method and Madness
nodes.tooltip: Your Infernal Offerings are more likely to share a category with your previous choice.

nodes.name: Infernal Hoard
nodes.tooltip: Defeating either the Fell Council or Bartuc reveals the Hoard of Greater Equipment, which contains a colossal deluge of equipment and other rewards.

nodes.name: Reign in Hell
nodes.tooltip: An additional Infernal Offering appears each wave. However, you suppress Chaos Waves from appearing.

nodes.name: Total Chaos
nodes.tooltip: Chaos Waves appear more frequently. However, one less Infernal Offering appears each wave.

nodes.name: Devil's Deal
nodes.tooltip: At the start of the Infernal Hordes, gain an Infernal Challenge. Completing the Infernal Challenge will grant +200 Aether.

nodes.name: Impending Doom
nodes.tooltip: When the current wave has 10 seconds remaining, Aether Events spawn at all locations.
nodes.seasonal: At Rank 14 with the Splinter of Terror, Impending Doom also triggers when the current wave has 30 seconds remaining.

nodes.name: Pulse of Aether
nodes.tooltip: Suppressing a Chaos Wave grants +50 Aether. All enemies in the Infernal Hordes gain +1 Monster Power.

nodes.name: Bedlam
nodes.tooltip: When you enter a Chaos Wave, gain +50 Aether and all enemies in the Infernal Hordes gain +1 Monster Power.

nodes.name: The Black Pact
nodes.tooltip: An ominous altar appears between waves in the Infernal Hordes. It can be invoked only once, and provides an Infernal Offering that shares a category with your previous choice.

nodes.name: Lair of Runes
nodes.tooltip: Lair Bosses have +1 Monster Power. Lair Bosses have a higher chances of dropping specific Runes.
nodes.seasonal: At Rank 14 with the Splinter of Destruction, Lair Bosses drop additional Runes.

nodes.name: Nemesis Tides
nodes.tooltip: Initiate Lair Bosses have a chance to appear instead of Helltide Commanders after Helltide Events. Killing Lair Bosses in Helltides while earning the Event Mastery grants many random Lair Boss materials. This only occurs in Torment+ difficulties.

nodes.name: Grigoire's Gambit
nodes.tooltip: After opening a Tortured Gift in Helltides, there is a chance Grigoire's knights will ambush you. When killed in Helltide, they may drop Unique Items available from his Hoard Chest.

nodes.name: Two by Two
nodes.tooltip: After opening a Hoard Chest, there is a low chance a Portal will open that will take you to the Nemesis Lair, where you will fight two Initiate Lair Bosses at the same time. Slaying both will yield great rewards. You cannot enter a Nemesis Lair from Belial's throne room.
nodes.seasonal: At Rank 18 with the Splinter of Destruction, the chance for a portal is increased.

nodes.name: Varshan's Vengeance
nodes.tooltip: Varshan and his minions can now appear in a Chaos Wave within the Infernal Hordes. After killing Varshan in the Infernal Hordes, the Spoils of Greater Equipment may drop Unique Items available from his Hoard Chest.

nodes.name: Children of Zir
nodes.tooltip: When exploring the Pit, Lord Zir's Bloodseekers can now ambush you. Killing them in the Pit can now drop Unique Items from his Hoard Chest.

nodes.name: Out of the Cold
nodes.tooltip: When fighting a Boss in a Nightmare Dungeon, the Beast in Ice has a chance to appear and attack you. When this occurs, killing the Nightmare Dungeon Boss has a chance to drop Unique Items from the Beast in Ice's Hoard Chest.

nodes.name: Duriel's Invasion
nodes.tooltip: When summoning the Blood Maiden in Helltides, there is a chance Duriel can be summoned instead. Killing Duriel in Helltides can now drop Unique Items from his Hoard Chest.

nodes.name: Greater Nemesis
nodes.tooltip: After completing a Nemesis Lair, there is a chance that a portal will appear that will take you to a Greater Nemesis Lair. Within this heinous place lies two Greater Lair Bosses. Slaying both bosses will yield great rewards.

nodes.name: Blood of Bartuc
nodes.tooltip: The Fell Council in the Infernal Hordes has +1 Monster Power. After defeating the Fell Council, the Spoils of Greater Equipment may drop Unique Items associated with Bartuc.

nodes.name: Lair of Plenty
nodes.tooltip: Lair Bosses have +1 Monster Power. Gain +1 Hoard Chest when you slay a Lair Boss (excluding Belial).

nodes.name: Embers of Anguish
nodes.tooltip: When exploring the Pit, Embers of Anguish can appear. Activating one drops Progress Orbs, and causes Andariel to ambush you at the end of the Pit. Killing Andariel in the Pit can now drop Unique Items from her Hoard Chest.

nodes.name: Dog of Astaroth
nodes.tooltip: When fighting a Boss in a Nightmare Dungeon, the Amalgam of Rage has a chance to appear and attack you. Killing the Amalgam of Rage in Nightmare Dungeons can drop Unique Items associated with Astaroth

nodes.name: Infernal Deception
nodes.tooltip: Belial can now ambush you after completing the Infernal Hordes.

nodes.name: Golden Hoard
nodes.tooltip: All equipment that would drop from Hoard Chests are converted to Gold, except for Unique and Mythic items.

nodes.name: Ultimate Nemesis
nodes.tooltip: After defeating all Bosses within the Greater Nemesis Lair, the Call Of Evil will appear. This altar will accept 3 Superior Lair Keys and open a Portal that takes you to the Ultimate Nemesis Lair. Inside the Ultimate Nemesis Lair, all enemies gain +5 Monster Power. Defeating the Boss Encounter will award you with 10 Hoard Chests worth of Items.

nodes.name: Exotic Armory
nodes.tooltip: Hoard Chests drop one additional Unique Item, but it can be for any Class.
nodes.seasonal: At Rank 20 with the Splinter of Destruction, Hoard Chests drop an additional 3 Unique Items for any Class.
